tim: heads-up — doing a quick pass on latency obs. where's the canonical dashboard for TTFT/p95/p99 and tokens/sec per model? need it for a sync with infra later.
obs-bot: auto: dashboard pinned: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd1234/latency-overview (TTFT panels, tokens/sec, model-slices)
jess: start here -> https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd1234/latency-overview?orgId=1&panelId=7 ; p95 TTFT panel is 7, p99 panel is 8, tokens/sec is panel 12.
jess: quick PromQL for p95 TTFT (ms):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) * 1000
```
jess: for tokens/sec per route:
```
sum(rate(inference_tokens_total[1m])) by (route, model)
```
mike: useful — how do we slice by model version / dedicated vs hosted? looking at spikes for small-models in dedicated pool.
sara: add `model` and `deployment_tier` labels to the queries, e.g. `... by (model, deployment_tier)`; Grafana has a var $model on that dashboard.
sara: alert tuning suggestion: p99 TTFT currently fires at 1200ms for the global alert — propose: split alerts by model class: small-models => 900ms, medium => 1500ms, large => 2500ms. reduces noisy paging for busy tiny-model traffic. here's a sample Alertmanager rule (yaml):
```
- alert: InferenceTTFTP99High_Small
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_class)) > 0.9
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "p99 TTFT high for small models"
```
alex: @sara can you open a PR with the split-rule + dashboard variable so oncall can tweak? i'll review.
sara: on it, will target `infra/alerts/ttft-split` branch. pinging oncall -> @mike please sanity-check thresholds.
mike: will do. also: if tokens/sec drops correlate with TTFT spike, check sampler logs: `kubectl logs -l app=sampler -c sampler -n inference --since=15m | grep rate-limit` — we've seen batching fallback when tokens/sec < 50/s.
jess: to trace a slow request: open Jaeger -> filter by trace tag `trace.reason=ttft_slow` and look for `kv_cache_miss` spans; example: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/trace/2345abcd
tim: perfect — this is exactly what i needed. last ask: can someone add a 1-line runbook blurb to the dashboard header: "check tokens/sec → sampler logs → kv cache hits → trace"? small PR fine.
sara: i'll add runbook blurb + link to runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/ttft-debug
obs-bot: note: alert `InferenceTTFT_GlobalHigh` muted for 2h for today's loadtest by @jess :thumbsup:
tim: thanks all :raised_hands:
